description: Manages the developer's own domain on THEIR Cloudflare (token connected via neblla_projects) and its mail. add: creates the zone, copies the public DNS and answers the two nameservers to set at the registrar, or `mismatch` with the differences (copy re-copies them). point_web {domain, appId}: domain is the bare example.com; serves the app at www and redirects the bare domain; without confirm it only says what it would replace. register is a billable purchase: the call only answers approveUrl for the developer to approve. transfer only answers the panelUrl where the developer pastes the auth code. mail_forward / mail_stop / mail_restore: forwarding to the developer's mailbox. remove leaves the zone on their Cloudflare. Without Cloudflare: neblla_update_app customDomain. More: neblla_get_llms tools/domains

accept.description: copy: go on despite the differences, only if the developer said so.

action.description: What to do. By action: add {domain}; copy {domain}; remove {domain}; point_web {domain, appId, confirm?}; unpoint_web {domain}; transfer {domain}; register {domain, autoRenew?}; mail_forward {domain, to, from?}; mail_stop {domain, from?}

appId.description: point_web: the app the web shows.

autoRenew.description: register: renew by itself every year (default false).

confirm.description: point_web: true applies the change to the web records.

from.description: mail_forward / mail_stop: "*" or an address of the domain.

projectId.description: The project, from neblla_projects_read list; left out, the account's.

replaceMailboxes.description: mail_forward: true replaces the other provider's mailboxes.

name: neblla_domains
title: Manage domains
